vivian_cs: Drafting a short note for tenants hit by today's ingest hiccup. Keeping it customer-friendly + clear next steps. please comment quick.

vivian_cs: Hi <customer name>,

We experienced a transient onboarding ingestion issue earlier today that affected indexing for some recent uploads. Engineers have deployed a fix and we are running targeted recovery for impacted tenants.

What we're doing now:
• Running tenant-specific reprocessing jobs (in progress)
• Spot-checking samples for correctness
• Prioritizing uploads that returned errors in the last 24 hours

What you may observe:
• Short delays in search or embeddings for recent uploads (most tenants will catch up within ~2 hours; larger datasets may take longer)
• No data was deleted or exposed

If you need fast help: reply with "PRIORITIZE" to request an expedited reprocess and a 1:1 enablement slot. Billing will follow up about a one-time credit for affected onboarding windows.

Support: support@redwood.ai or slack #support (business hours)

—Vivian, Customer Success

noah_ae: LGTM. ira, can you host a 30m hand-hold slot tomorrow for renewal-risk customers?

ira_enable: yes, I'll reserve a slot and share signup link after outbound goes.
